map.简易精神状态检查(MMSE)30项量表，总分30分，用于认知障碍筛查: 30-item Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) scale, 30 points total, used for cognitive impairment screening
map.请逐项评分后查看结果: Score each item to see the result
map.需进一步评估，可能为MCI: Needs further assessment, may be MCI
map.日常生活需部分协助: Needs partial help with daily life
map.日常生活需全面照顾: Needs full care for daily life
map.文盲≤17分、小学≤20分、初中及以上≤24分提示认知障碍。该量表广泛用于痴呆筛: Illiterate <=17 points, primary school <=20 points, junior high or above <=24 points suggests cognitive impairment. This scale is widely used for dementia screening, with about 80% sensitivity and about 90% specificity.
map.合计 18（11-20 橙区），中度损害，需照料者参与并排除可逆因素（营养/药物: Total 18 (11-20 orange zone), moderate impairment, a caregiver should join in and reversible factors (nutrition / medication / depression) should be excluded.
map.文盲老人分数偏低怎么判？: How should low scores in illiterate elderly people be judged?
map.MMSE 受教育程度影响大：文盲不高于 17 分、小学不高于 20 分、中学及以: The MMSE is strongly affected by education level: cognitive impairment is only judged at no more than 17 for illiterate, no more than 20 for primary school, and no more than 24 for junior high or above; using a uniform 24-point cutoff would massively misjudge elderly people with low education. Also the serial 7s subtractions and backwards word recall depend heavily on hearing and attention, so people with hearing impairment should wear a hearing aid before testing. The MMSE is insensitive to early mild cognitive impairment (MCI), so MoCA can be added when necessary.
map.关于「认知障碍(MMSE)量表自动计分器」: About the Cognitive Impairment (MMSE) Scale Auto-Scorer
map.认知障碍(MMSE)量表自动计分器。医疗专业工具，基于权威医学标准，仅供参考。: Cognitive Impairment (MMSE) Scale Auto-Scorer. A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
map.≥27正常；文盲≤17/小学≤20/中学及以上≤24提示障碍；低于界值再分21-: ≥27 normal; education cutoffs 17/20/24 indicate impairment; below the cutoff, 21-26 mild, 11-20 moderate, ≤10 severe
map.逐项录入MMSE 30项量表得分，自动汇总总分（满分30）并提示认知障碍程度分级: Enter item scores for the 30-point MMSE to total the score (maximum 30) and indicate a cognitive impairment level, for initial screening of cognitive decline and memory loss in older adults.
map.指导语：先清晰读出“皮球、国旗、树木”三个词，请受试者立即复述；允许重复朗读最多: Instructions: read the three words ball, flag and tree clearly, then ask the examinee to repeat them immediately. You may repeat the words up to 3 times until learned; score the number of words correctly repeated on the first attempt (1 point each). This part tests registration only, not delayed recall; part IV asks for the same three words again.
map.指导语：在完成注意力和计算、语言等项目后，请受试者回忆第二部分曾登记的三个词；每: Instructions: after attention/calculation and language items, ask the examinee to recall the three words registered in part II; 1 point per correct word, without cues.
map.痴呆与认知障碍初筛：按定向、即刻记忆、注意/计算、延迟回忆、语言五部分计分。: Dementia and cognitive impairment screening across orientation, immediate memory, attention/calculation, delayed recall and language.
map.治疗或随访对比：同一患者前后复测，观察总分变化。: Before/after comparison: repeat the test in the same patient and track total-score change.
map.术前/入院认知基线评估：为后续谵妄或功能下降提供参照。: Preoperative or admission cognitive baseline for later delirium or functional decline.
map.定向 9＋即刻记忆 3＋注意/计算 4＋延迟回忆 2＋语言 6＝24/30，落: Orientation 9 + immediate memory 3 + attention/calculation 4 + delayed recall 2 + language 6 = 24/30 (21–26, mild); below 27, further cognitive assessment is recommended.
map.合计 18，落 11–20 中度区间；需照料者参与，并排除营养、药物、抑郁等可逆: Total 18 (11–20, moderate); involve caregivers and exclude reversible factors such as nutrition, medications and depression.
map.≥27 正常、21–26 轻度、11–20 中度、≤10 重度（满分 30，含定: ≥27 normal, 21–26 mild, 11–20 moderate, ≤10 severe (maximum 30, covering orientation, immediate memory, attention/calculation, delayed recall and language).
map.第二部分“登记”和第四部分“回忆”有什么区别？: What is the difference between part II registration and part IV recall?
map.第二部分是即刻登记：读出“皮球、国旗、树木”后让受试者马上复述，可重复朗读最多: Part II is immediate registration: read ball, flag and tree, then have the examinee repeat them at once; up to 3 repetitions are allowed and the first-attempt correct words are scored. Part IV is delayed recall: after attention/calculation and language items, ask for the same three words without cues. They measure immediate registration versus delayed retrieval and must not be merged into one item.
map.MMSE 受教育程度影响大：文盲不高于 17 分、小学不高于 20 分、中学及以: The MMSE is strongly education-dependent: impairment cutoffs are ≤17 for illiterate, ≤20 for primary school and ≤24 for junior high or above; a uniform 24-point cutoff would overdiagnose many low-education elders. People with hearing impairment should wear a hearing aid before testing. The MMSE is insensitive to early mild cognitive impairment, so add MoCA when needed.
map.MMSE 共 30 分，覆盖定向、即刻记忆（登记）、注意/计算、延迟回忆与语言五: The 30-point MMSE covers orientation, immediate memory (registration), attention/calculation, delayed recall and language; it is used for dementia screening, follow-up comparison and cognitive baseline assessment, with education-adjusted interpretation.
